summary: Reading International, Inc. through subsidiary Sutton Hill Properties, LLC entered a Contract of Sale on August 31, 2026 to sell its cinema property at 1001-1007 Third Avenue, New York (Cinemas 1, 2 & 3) to 1001 Third Avenue LLC for $41 million. A $4.1 million down payment was placed in escrow; closing, not subject to due diligence or financing contingencies, is expected on or about October 30, 2026. The property carries an existing mortgage of about $19 million to be satisfied at closing. No board recommendation or advisors are disclosed. Watch for the closing and use of net proceeds.
